variant_a.subhead: Persistent memory across every LLM you use. Claude, GPT, Qwen, Gemini, your local model — all drawing from the same locally-stored knowledge graph.
variant_a.body: Stop the paste-context-fatigue cycle. Your context lives once, persists across models, and compounds with every session you finish.

variant_b.headline_lead: AI workspace that satisfies your CISO.
variant_b.subhead: Local-first by default, EU AI Act audit reports built into the workflow, backed by Egzakta Group's regulated-industries practice.
variant_b.body: Your CISO blocked ChatGPT for good reasons. Waggle keeps the work on your machine and generates Article 12 audit reports automatically — no separate compliance workstream.

variant_c.headline_lead: Your team's memory, before someone has to write it down.
variant_c.subhead: Notion wikis go stale. Slack search is hostile. Waggle captures the context as you work — no extra step.
variant_c.body: Onboarding an 8-person team gets shorter when context auto-organizes from work activity, not from someone remembering to write the wiki page.

variant_d.headline_lead: Memory layer that doesn't lock you to a vendor.
variant_d.subhead: Apache 2.0, MCP-native, runs locally. The substrate plugs into whatever agent harness you're already running.
variant_d.body: Mem0 is cloud-only. LangMem is toy-tier. Letta is agent-centric. Waggle is the substrate — fork the source, audit the graph, deploy on your infra.

variant_e.headline_lead: AI that never sees your client matter.
variant_e.subhead: Local-first by design, bar association compatible, full audit log per matter — work stays on your machine.
variant_e.body: ChatGPT-as-malpractice-risk has stalled adoption in legal. Waggle's hive lives on the device; every recall carries provenance, every matter has a trail.

hero.eyebrow: The AI workspace for experts, not AI experts.
hero.headline: Be the expert. We'll be the AI.
hero.subhead: You didn't become an expert to babysit a model. Do your work; we'll run the AI.
hero.secondary_cta: Want the full controls back? They're one click away.

hero_visual.svg_aria_label: Hive memory connecting four LLM providers

proof.headline: The layer does the work.
proof.subhead: It remembers what you told it — verified, not vibes. On an independent memory test, three rival AI models had to agree before an answer counted; it passed 67.8% of the time. Run the test yourself, offline.
proof.methodology: The "three rival models had to agree" test is the LoCoMo benchmark scored by a 3-vendor judge ensemble — Opus, GPT, and MiniMax, AND-of-3 (an answer counts only when all three independently agree). Conservative, cross-vendor, and reproducible offline: 67.8%. The 0.3-point convergence is 73.1 vs 73.4 on the same memory layer.

pillars.headline: Two memories working together: one that knows how you like to work, one that knows the work itself — so you never start from a stranger.

pillar_01.title: It knows you
pillar_01.body: You're known here — so you never re-introduce yourself, never start from a stranger again. It already knows how you think and how you like your work done.

pillar_02.title: It knows your work
pillar_02.body: Nothing is lost — walk back into any project after a day, a week, a quarter, and it's all still there, exactly as you left it.

pillar_03.title: It runs the AI
pillar_03.body: You stay the expert in your work. The prompting, routing, and scaffolding run underneath — on tap when you want them, out of your way when you don't. Keep every control you have today; we just stop making you use them.

pillar_04.title: Your best work, and it's yours
pillar_04.body: Excel built to the last detail, decks that hold up in the room, Word polished to the final word — every kind of work, start to finish. Everything you ship is genuinely your best, and unmistakably yours.

pillar_05.title: It stays yours
pillar_05.body: Local-first and model-agnostic — it runs on any model, even a small one on your own machine. It lives on your machine and your account — yours to keep, export, or delete anytime.

comparison.eyebrow: AI for doing your work — not operating it.
comparison.headline: All the power of the tools built for engineers. None of the homework.
comparison.body: The most powerful AI tools were built for people who want to operate AI — endless settings, prompts, and plumbing to master before you produce anything. Waggle takes the opposite bet: your time is too valuable to spend on AI plumbing, so we run it for you and hand back the finished work. You didn't become an expert to babysit a model.

wow.headline: It's 6pm. You thought about your work all day — not the AI.
wow.body: You didn't wrestle a prompt or babysit a pipeline — you made the call, shaped the argument, sweated the detail only you would catch. The deliverable is done, it's unmistakably yours, and you could swap models freely along the way — the output is yours, and you can always see exactly how it was made.

how_it_works.headline: A simple division of labor.
how_it_works.subhead: You bring the judgment. Waggle brings the AI. Open it once and your context and your work-in-progress are already there waiting — nothing re-explained, nothing lost.

step_01.title: Bring it all in
step_01.body: Start fresh and it learns you fast — or bring your history in. One-click import from ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor is rolling out now: imported on your machine, stays on your machine.

step_02.title: Open to what's waiting
step_02.body: Open it and you're already moving: here's where you left off, here's what's next — your work picks up mid-stride, never from a blank box.

step_03.title: Do the work that's yours
step_03.body: You make the calls; Waggle runs the AI underneath and hands you finished work — and when you close it, all of it stays right where you left it for next time.

personas_section.subtitle: Hunters chase, builders ship, orchestrators coordinate. Waggle remembers — across roles, across tools, across the moments in between.
